title: TC-ZOOM-001: Dragging a brush on a time-series chart switches the dashboard to an absolute range
verifies: a brush drag on a line chart flips the dashboard global time from relative to an absolute range and re-queries the panel

title: TC-DRAG-001: Dragging a panel's header bar repositions it and saves the layout
verifies: a header-bar drag moves the panel in the grid and persists the new layout via a dashboard PUT

title: TC-ZOOM-002: Dragging on a pie chart does not change the global time range
verifies: the same drag on a non-time-series pie chart leaves the global time range relative
